# Creality fixtures

`status_idle_k1c.json` is the first message a K1C 2025 with a CFS sent over its
status channel on 2026-11-22, with the host name replaced. The other files are
written by hand to the `boxsInfo` schema documented in OrcaSlicer's
`CrealityPrintAgent.cpp` (verified there on a K2 Combo); no printer produced them.
